title: Egg Potato Tomato Curry
instructions: Boil eggs and potatoes; saute chopped tomato and spices; simmer together until cooked.

title: Potato Tomato Bhaji
instructions: Dice potatoes and tomatoes, then saute and cook covered until tender.

title: Tomato Omelette
instructions: Beat egg with chopped tomato and salt, then cook thoroughly in a pan.

title: Potato Egg Omelette
instructions: Use cooked grated potato with beaten egg; pan cook both sides.

title: Vegetable Khichuri
instructions: Wash rice and lentils, add vegetables, water and spices, simmer until soft.

title: Egg Fried Rice
instructions: Stir-fry cooked rice and vegetables with thoroughly cooked egg.

title: Tomato Dal
instructions: Cook lentils until tender; add sauteed tomato and spices.

title: Potato Mash
instructions: Boil potato, mash with finely chopped onion, salt and mustard oil.

title: Egg Curry
instructions: Hard-boil egg, saute vegetables and spices, simmer in sauce.

title: Vegetable Stir Fry
instructions: Slice vegetables thinly and cook in pan until tender.

title: Banana Oatmeal
instructions: Heat oats with milk until cooked and top with sliced banana.

title: Tomato Soup
instructions: Simmer chopped vegetables in water and blend carefully.

title: Boiled Egg Salad
instructions: Hard-boil egg and chop alongside washed vegetables.

title: Potato Onion Fry
instructions: Slice vegetables and pan-fry until cooked.

title: Carrot Rice
instructions: Saute carrot and onion, add washed rice and water and cook.

title: Chicken Curry
instructions: Heat oil and saute onion, ginger and garlic. Add tomato, turmeric and salt. Add chicken and cook with a little water until completely cooked through.

title: Chicken Potato Curry
instructions: Saute chopped onion and turmeric in oil. Add chicken and potato pieces with water. Simmer until chicken is thoroughly cooked and potatoes are tender.

title: Chicken Khichuri
instructions: Wash rice and lentils. Saute onion and chicken with turmeric. Add rice, lentils and sufficient water. Cook until the chicken is thoroughly cooked and the rice and lentils are soft.

title: Beef Curry
instructions: Saute onion, ginger and garlic in oil. Add beef, turmeric and salt. Add water and simmer until the beef is fully cooked and tender.

title: Beef Potato Curry
instructions: Cook onion and ginger in oil. Add beef and spices with water. Simmer until partly tender, add potatoes and continue cooking until the meat and potatoes are fully cooked.

title: Mutton Curry
instructions: Saute onion, ginger and garlic. Add mutton, turmeric, salt and water. Cook over low heat until the mutton is thoroughly cooked and tender.

title: Mutton Potato Curry
instructions: Saute onion in oil with turmeric. Add mutton and water, then simmer until partly tender. Add potatoes and continue cooking until everything is tender.

title: Rohu Fish Curry
instructions: Season fish with turmeric and salt. Lightly fry in oil. Simmer potato and tomato with water and spices, then add fish and cook until fully cooked.

title: Hilsa Fish Curry
instructions: Heat mustard oil, add turmeric, salt and green chili. Add water and hilsa pieces. Simmer gently until the fish is completely cooked.

title: Pangas Fish Curry
instructions: Saute onion and tomato in oil with turmeric. Add water and pangas fish. Simmer gently until the fish is thoroughly cooked.

title: Fish and Potato Curry
instructions: Saute onion and tomato with turmeric. Add potato pieces and water. When potatoes are almost tender, add fish and cook until fully cooked.

title: Shrimp Curry
instructions: Saute onion and garlic with tomato and turmeric. Add cleaned shrimp and cook until shrimp is opaque and fully cooked.

title: Shrimp with Bottle Gourd
instructions: Saute onion and turmeric in oil. Add chopped bottle gourd and cook until soft. Add cleaned shrimp and cook thoroughly.

title: Masoor Dal
instructions: Wash lentils and boil with water and turmeric until soft. Saute onion in oil and add it to the cooked lentils. Season with salt.

title: Chickpea Curry
instructions: Soak dried chickpeas and cook until tender. Saute onion and tomato with turmeric. Add cooked chickpeas, a little water and salt. Simmer together.

title: Vegetable Dal
instructions: Wash lentils and chop vegetables. Add everything to a pot with water and turmeric. Simmer until lentils and vegetables are tender.

title: Mixed Vegetable Curry
instructions: Saute onion and turmeric in oil. Add chopped vegetables with a little water. Cover and cook until all vegetables are tender.

title: Cauliflower Potato Curry
instructions: Saute tomato and turmeric in oil. Add cauliflower and potato pieces with a little water. Cover and cook until tender.

title: Bottle Gourd Curry
instructions: Peel and chop bottle gourd. Saute onion and green chili in oil. Add bottle gourd and salt, cover and cook until tender.

title: Eggplant Bhorta
instructions: Roast eggplant until soft and fully cooked. Remove the skin and mash with chopped onion, green chili, mustard oil and salt.

title: Potato Bhorta
instructions: Boil peeled potatoes until tender. Mash with finely chopped onion, green chili, mustard oil and salt.

title: Pumpkin Bhaji
instructions: Cut pumpkin into small pieces. Saute onion and turmeric in oil, add pumpkin and salt, and cook covered until soft.

title: Spinach Bhaji
instructions: Wash spinach thoroughly. Saute chopped onion and garlic in oil. Add spinach and cook until wilted and tender.

title: Chicken Vegetable Soup
instructions: Place chicken and chopped vegetables in a pot with water. Simmer until chicken is thoroughly cooked and vegetables are tender. Season with salt.

title: Banana Milk Smoothie
instructions: Peel and slice banana. Blend with pasteurized milk until smooth. Serve immediately.
